x, y, limit = map(int, input().split())

def compute_gcd(a, b):
    return a if b == 0 else compute_gcd(b, a % b)

ratio = x / y
min_diff = float('inf')
ans_num, ans_den = 0, 1

for i in range(1, limit + 1):
    b = (x * i) // y
    a = b / i
    a_minus = abs(b - 1) / i
    a_plus = (b + 1) / i

    if abs(ratio - a) < min_diff:
        ans_num, ans_den = b, i
        min_diff = abs(ratio - a)
    if abs(ratio - a_minus) < min_diff:
        ans_num, ans_den = abs(b - 1), i
        min_diff = abs(ratio - a_minus)
    if abs(ratio - a_plus) < min_diff:
        ans_num, ans_den = b + 1, i
        min_diff = abs(ratio - a_plus)

if abs(1.0 - ratio) <= (abs(ans_num / ans_den) - ratio) + 1e-9:
    ans_num, ans_den = 1, 1

g = compute_gcd(ans_num, ans_den)
print(f"{ans_num // g}/{ans_den // g}")
